data.name: Irha
data.gender_notes: Irha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'رح', which signifies comfort, ease, and relief. The name Irha carries the meaning “Comfort, relief” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Irha usually hope their child will grow to embody comfort, relief and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of the comfort and solace found in God's presence, especially during times of hardship.
data.etymology: Irha belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Comfort, relief.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Irha total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: إرها
in_arabic.meaning: إرها تعني الرحمة و العطف و الإحسان
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم إرها مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ر-ح-م' والذي يعني الرحمة و العطف و الإحسان. ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في سياق الحديث عن الرحمة الربانية و الإحسان إلى الناس. يعتبر اسم إرها من الأسماء الجميلة و الراقية التي تعبر عن صفات حميدة و أخلاق عالية.

in_urdu.name: ارہا
in_urdu.meaning: ارہا رحمت اور نیکی کا مطلب ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام ارہا عربی جڑ 'ر-ح-م' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے رحمت، خیر خواہی اور نیکی۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان مقبول ہے اور اسلامی روایت میں اس کی روحانی اہمیت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: इरहा
in_hindi.meaning: इरहा का अर्थ है दया और अच्छाई
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम इरहा अरबी मूल 'र-ह-म' से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है दया, доброई और नेकी। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में प्रयोग किया जाता है और इसकी पृष्ठभूमि इस्लामी परंपरा में है।

in_english.name: Irha
in_english.meaning: Irha means mercy, kindness, and goodness
in_english.long_meaning: The name Irha is derived from the Arabic root 'ر-ح-م' (R-H-M), which signifies mercy, kindness, and goodness. It appears in the Quranic context as a description of divine mercy and benevolence towards humanity. Irha is considered a beautiful and elegant name reflecting virtuous qualities and high moral standards. Historically, it holds significance in Islamic tradition and is used across various Muslim cultures.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Irha" holds significant importance in Islamic culture as it is mentioned in the Hadiths (sayings of Prophet Muhammad) and Quranic commentaries. For instance, Prophet Muhammad is reported to have said, "When Allah desires to ease a believer's condition, He removes from him worries and signifies it to him through the poverty that he sees, for poverty is a sign of ease." In this context, the name "Irha" holds the symbolism of God's mercy and comfort, especially during times of hardship.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual realm, the name "Irha" represents the comfort and relief that one experiences when they turn towards Allah for guidance and succor. It serves as a reminder of the quintessential promise in the Quran that "Allah will certainly help those who help His (cause): For He is a Forgiver Most Merciful." Hence, this name rekindles the faith of the believer in God's divine providence and infinite mercy.
